name: Beijing Urban Construction Investment & Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Urban Construction Investment & Development Co., Ltd. engages in the acquisition and development of real estate properties in China. The company is involved in the development of residential, apartments, villas, commercial, hotels, office buildings, and cultural tourism properties. It also engages in renting of real estate and property management services. Beijing Urban Construction Investment & Development Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Beijing, China.
